title: AMC 8 Practice: Polygon Angles — How Many Sides?
description:
AMC 8 practice problem on the angles of a convex polygon with two right angles and all other angles 160 degrees: how many sides? (Level 4 of 5)
Two corners are square and every other corner is 160 degrees. How many sides does the polygon have? Vantee takes a walk around the outside, where the turns always add up to 360 degrees, then checks the answer with the inside-angle sum.
She also shows why each wrong choice is tempting and gives you a new set of corners to try yourself.
